description: Retrieves Shared Data by HTTP GET on the Shared Data resource.

constraints.statement: The Service Consumer shall send an HTTP GET request to the resource URI "shared-data/{sharedDataId}".
evidence: "The Service Consumer shall send an HTTP GET request to the resource URI \"shared-data/{sharedDataId}\" document resource"
constraints.why_interesting: This is the core request shape and is directly testable by checking the method and URI.

constraints.statement: The URI parameter sharedDataId shall identify the requested Shared Data.
evidence: "where the URI parameter sharedDataId identifies the requested Shared Data"
constraints.why_interesting: This constrains the meaning of the path parameter and can be validated by request routing/lookup behavior.

constraints.statement: On success, the NRF shall return 200 OK.
evidence: "On success, \"200 OK\" shall be returned with the requested Shared Data in response body."
constraints.why_interesting: This defines the required success status code for the operation.

constraints.statement: On success, the response body shall contain the requested Shared Data.
evidence: "On success, \"200 OK\" shall be returned with the requested Shared Data in response body."
constraints.why_interesting: This is an observable response payload requirement.

constraints.statement: On failure, the NRF shall return a 4xx or 5xx response.
evidence: "On failure, the NRF shall return \"4xx/5xx\" response"
constraints.why_interesting: This constrains the failure status code class and is testable.

constraints.statement: On failure, the response body may contain a ProblemDetails object describing the detailed information of the failure.
evidence: "the response body may contain a ProblemDetails object describing the detailed information of the failure"
constraints.why_interesting: This identifies an optional error payload that can be checked when present.

constraints.statement: In case of redirection, the NRF shall return a 3xx status code.
evidence: "In the case of redirection, the NRF shall return 3xx status code"
constraints.why_interesting: This specifies the required redirect status class.

constraints.statement: In case of redirection, the NRF response shall contain a Location header.
constraints.why_interesting: This is a concrete header requirement for redirect handling.

constraints.statement: In case of redirection, the Location header shall contain a URI pointing to the endpoint of another NRF service instance.
evidence: "with an URI pointing to the endpoint of another NRF service instance"
constraints.why_interesting: This constrains the redirect target and is observable in the Location header value.
